mapper.select: select date_format(checkout_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as date, sum(amount) as value from service_order where pay_status = 1 and status in (5, 6) and checkout_time >= #{begin} and checkout_time < #{end} group by date_format(checkout_time, '%Y-%m-%d') order by date

select date_format(order_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as date, count(id) as total, sum(case when status in (5, 6) then 1 else 0 end) as valid from service_order where order_time >= #{begin} and order_time < #{end} group by date_format(order_time, '%Y-%m-%d') order by date
select count(id) from user where create_time < #{before}
select count(id) from service_order where order_time < #{before}
